description: Figure 4 presents a comparison of performance metrics for two models—a Joint Framework and a Dual-LLM Framework—on the SEconvo dataset. The horizontal axis lists five performance metrics: Accuracy, Run-time, Interpretability, Efficiency, and Streaming Readiness. The vertical axis lists the two models being compared, with “Joint Framework” at the top and “Dual-LLM Framework” at the bottom. The Accuracy metric shows values of 0.82 for the Joint Framework and 0.90 for the Dual-LLM Framework. The Run-time metric displays 77s for the Joint Framework and 172s (labeled “fastest”) for the Dual-LLM Framework. Interpretability is labeled as “Medium” for the Joint Framework and “High” for the Dual-LLM Framework. Efficiency is labeled as “High” for the Joint Framework and “Moderate-Low” for the Dual-LLM Framework. Finally, Streaming Readiness is labeled as “Strong” for the Joint Framework and “Moderate” for the Dual-LLM Framework. The data is presented in a table format with a horizontal line separating the header row from the data rows, and another line separating the two models. No bars are present, and no visual emphasis is applied to any specific data point.
